run_boost_mpl_preprocess: run the boost mpl preprocessed header generator script with a boost source directory
create_numbered_sequence_files: create additional source and header files for numbered sequence MPL containers up to max elements
adjust_variadic_limits: adjust the container size limits in variadic sequence MPL header files to a new max value
detect_boost_source_dir: detect the relative path to the boost source directory from the current script location
validate_positive_multiple_of_10: validate that a string is a positive integer that is a multiple of 10
